Il Foglio’s latest innovation is to give its readers more choice around how they consume their content. With a growing number of readers wanting to get their news and analysis on the go, Il Foglio decided to transform its daily editorials into high-quality audio articles. However, the newspaper couldn't afford to pull journalists away from investigative work to sit in front of a microphone for hours every day. It needed a solution that offered human broadcast quality while keeping its team free to meet the demands of a busy newsroom. We compared a range of solutions, and Chirp 3: HD Voices stood out for the quality of its voices. It was the natural-sounding spoken language that persuaded us to choose Google Cloud.
